body.name: \(\mathsf G_m(\lambda,\alpha)\)
body.construction: Factor \(P_{n,m,Q_a}(h)=\rho_{n,m,h}(\lambda)a^h\) and minimize \(\ell\) over \(a\in\mathcal A_\lambda\) and \(d\) subject to \(0\le d_{h,t}\le a^h\), \(\sum_h\rho_{n,m,h}(\lambda)d_{h,\tau(n)}\ge1-\alpha\), and \(\sum_{h,t}\rho_{n,m,h}(\lambda)d_{h,t}\le\ell\) for every \(n\in\mathcal O_N\).
